responsibility: Central X-macro table of GCC diagnostic kinds. It assigns the stable diagnostic_t categories, their human-facing textual prefixes, and associated color class names for fatal errors, ICEs, warnings, notes, path displays, pedwarn/permerror intermediates, and warning-promoted-to-error bookkeeping, so headers and implementations can generate enums and kind tables from one source of truth.
same_name_distinction: Data-definition file within the diagnostic stem group: unlike diagnostic.h's API declarations and diagnostic.cc's executable engine logic, this file is the shared X-macro list that enumerates diagnostic kinds and associates each with its text prefix and color category.
